name: arm_motion
title: Balance on two legs while moving the arms in 3-D
summary: The robot holds the deterministic two-leg stand and rides a looping routine of bilateral arm EXERCISES -- lateral raises, arm circles, elbow curls, a marching arm swing, a wave, and a double-biceps flex -- so the arms move freely in 3-D while the legs keep balancing. Composes with -Throw (exercise while taking external cube hits). The hand positions are FK-computed each tick ('aware of its hands') and logged.
owns_effectors: both arms (shoulder pitch/roll/yaw, elbow, wrist) via a superimposed exercise sinusoid
balance_by: arm_balance (kept LIVE -- the marginal stand needs the arms as its fast balancer; the exercise rides on top)
hip auto_trim with a mild D assist
forward-kinematics CoM-back feedforward (hip + ankle) proportional to how far the hands extend ahead of rest
a rest dwell between exercises so the stand re-centres
design_rule: Motions must be lateral-dominant, fore/aft-CANCELLING (alternating), or distal. BILATERAL FORWARD arm raises topple G1's marginal forward-CoM stand and are excluded -- forward motion is done as an alternating march (arm_swing) and reach is angled out (lateral). See the doc for the full journal.

verified.result: 0 falls over 206 s sim (2+ full loops of all 6 exercises), ends upright (pitch within +/-0.06 rad throughout). With -Throw: 0 falls, 5/8 cube throws scored solid torso HITs and were absorbed while exercising.
